name: @shogun-ai/web
description: shogunagent.com. An agent-first landing page: content/site.json is the single source, build.mjs renders index.html, index.md, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, setup-prompt.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml from it, and src/worker.js serves Markdown to agents that ask for it. No runtime dependencies.

scripts.typecheck: node --check build.mjs && node --check src/worker.js && node --check scripts/serve.mjs
